## get_schedule_patient.php

Dolgozik Imre azon hogy telefonszamot tudjon vissza adni az API es results_count + name fieldeket, megtortenhet hogy egy csaladon belul 3 szemely ugyanazon a telefonszamon legyen programalva. Itt 2FA method lesz, telefonszam es nev alapjan fogjuk majd mi itt queryzni a usereket

# Tools
## check_availability
-> agent prompted by user to make an appointment but before calling this tool asks about city, preferred location, preferred doctor, *date* -> get_auth | get_info | get_work_days -> returns earliest available slots 

**possibility: user wants to make appointment 2 months later -> date_from parameter needs to change to 2 months - 1 day later** 

[itt beszeltem Imrevel a meetben, ez ugy mukodik a date_from parameter, hogy kotelezoen jovobeli datum kell legyen es keresni fog a calendarban 15 munkanapot amelyiken van szabad idopont. peldaul ha Dr. Baricz Anna minden heten kedden es szerdan rendel, akkor 15 kedden es szerdan megy keresztul ahol van szabad slot. minden slot 15 perc]

## book_appointment
-> agents asks for personal information: full name, phone number, preferred slot from before, problem description (observations field in the API)

**possibility: user is an existing patient, full name and phone number will create an appointment type slot in the evolvo calendar not an agenda insertion. appointment type slots contain real pacient information from the CRM and history on them, agenda insertions are what they call internally "leads"**


**v4 (2026-09-07):** after the slot check, `get_patient.php` looks the phone up; exactly one name match → `post_schedule.php (patient)` with `patientid` (real appointment, name/email/phone ignored by evolvo); otherwise the lead path. Ambiguous matches → `ambiguous_patient` error.

## find_appointments
-> user wants to find an appointment / asks explicitly for info about it -> auth method is phone number dictated digit by digit and full name

## manage_appointment
-> user wants to manage found appointment after auth with phone number and full name -> states action (cancel, reschedule)

Called by the ElevenLabs voice agent.

**Input (JSON body):** doctor?, city?, location?, date_from? (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to tomorrow)

**Output:** matching calendars with their next free days/times, or option lists when the query is ambiguous.

Flow: auth (cached token) -> get_info -> match calendar(s) -> get_work_days per calendar (max 4).

## TOOL: book_appointment

Called by the ElevenLabs voice agent AFTER the caller confirmed all details out loud.

**Input (JSON body):** full_name, phone, date (YYYY-MM-DD), time (HH:MM 24h), doctor and/or location (must resolve to exactly one calendar), problem?, email?

The caller's problem goes into the API's *observations* field (per Imreh: problemDescription is NOT the right field).

Flow: auth -> get_info -> match ONE calendar -> get_work_days -> find exact slot -> post_schedule.

Creates an 'agenda insertion' (lead) in evolvo. If name+phone match an existing patient it becomes a real appointment with CRM history.

**Input (JSON body):** phone, full_name, date (of the appointment, YYYY-MM-DD), action (confirm|cancel|reschedule), note?

Flow: auth -> get_schedule_patient -> match record by name+date -> update_schedule (state 1/2/3).

NOTE (sticky from planning): 'api still needed' - if get_schedule_patient does not return a scheduleid for the record, this tool answers not_supported_yet gracefully.

## LOG — escalation / callback requests (2026-09-07)
POST /webhook/optofarm-log-request (X-Optofarm-Secret). Body: request_type (order_status|price_enquiry|stock_enquiry|complaint|b2b_lead|callback|other), patient_name, phone, summary, language, branch?, idempotency_key (= ElevenLabs conversation id, deduped 6h). Appends a row to the Google Sheet 'Optofarm – Voice Agent Requests' / tab 'Requests' (credential 'Google Sheets account'). Sheet append failure → success:false log_failed, the call is NOT dropped.

Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GServAn1IQuaMzLPgMB0faAt0rdN1Znk8U_1w3Ht7sc (owner hunor@splitagency.eu, shared with office@splitagency.eu as editor). ElevenLabs tool: evolvo_log_request.
